title: 'Why I Would Rather Be an Illustrator'
content: When he was asked whether he ever had the desire, as have had so many illustrators, to go in for what is known as 'straight painting,' Dean Cornwell replied:"It is love of romance that makes Americans the greatest readers of fiction, and producers of the greatest number of films. That is one reason why I would rather be an illustrator than do so-called straight painting. I appeal to this spirit in thousands of people, whereas if I painted a picture and showed in an exhibition, and if it were lucky enough to be bought, only a few people would see it."--"Dean Cornwell: Factor in a New Art" article by Helen Appleton Read inThe Brooklyn Daily Eagle,1924, fromFulton History.
